translations.text: The number of his troops was fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
The total number of troops in the camp of Ephraim was one hundred eight thousand one hundred. They shall set out after the two.
They shall look after all the equipment of the tent of meeting and carry out the duties of the Israelites, performing the service of the tabernacle.
You shall give the Levites to Aaron and his sons. They are given to him as a gift from among the Israelites.
Look, I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites in place of every firstborn who opens the womb among the Israelites, so that the Levites shall be mine.

For every firstborn is mine. On the day when I killed every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to myself every firstborn of the Israelites, both human and livestock. They shall be mine. I am the Lord.
To Merari belonged the clan of Mahli and the clan of Mushi. These are the clans of Merari.
Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
You shall count the descendants of Merari by their clans and their ancestral households.
From thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old: everyone who enters the service to perform the work of ministry and the service of carrying loads in the tent of meeting.
Speak to the Israelites and say to them: If any man's wife goes astray and acts unfaithfully toward him,
Throughout all the days of his Nazirite vow, he is holy to the Lord.
He gave nothing to the descendants of Kohath, because the service of the holy things was entrusted to them, and they carried them on their shoulders.
The Lord said to Moses: One leader each day shall present his offerings for the dedication of the altar.
For the sacrifice of peace offerings: two bulls, five rams, five young goats, and five year-old lambs. This was the offering of Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
One male goat for a sin offering.
For the sacrifice of peace offerings: two bulls, five rams, five young goats, and five year-old lambs. This was the offering of Eliasaph son of Reuel.
One young bull, one ram, and one year-old lamb for a burnt offering.
One young bull, one ram, and one year-old lamb for a burnt offering.

His offering was one silver dish weighing one hundred thirty shekels and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels according to the sanctuary shekel, both filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering.
For the sacrifice of peace offerings: two bulls, five rams, five young goats, and five year-old lambs. This was the offering of Pagiel son of Ocran.
Take the Levites from among the Israelites and purify them.
Separate the Levites from among the Israelites, and the Levites shall be mine.
There were men who were unclean because of a human corpse and could not celebrate the Passover on that day. They came before Moses and Aaron that day.
Whenever the cloud rose from the tabernacle, the Israelites would then set out. Wherever the cloud settled, there the Israelites would camp.

Sometimes the cloud would remain over the tabernacle from evening until morning. When the cloud rose in the morning, they would set out. Whether by day or by night, when the cloud rose, they would set out.

Whether for days or months or from one season to another, as long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle, the Israelites would remain camped and would not set out. When the cloud rose, they would set out.
They shall blow them, and the whole congregation shall assemble before you at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
They shall sound the horn a second time, and the camps stationed on the south shall set out. They shall blow the horn when they set out.

On your days of rejoicing, at your festivals, and at the beginnings of your months, blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and your peace offerings. They shall serve as a reminder for you before your God. I am the Lord your God.
The Israelites set out on their journeys from the wilderness of Sinai, and the cloud settled in the wilderness of Paran.
The commander of the forces of the tribe of Benjamin was Abidan son of Gideoni.
The commander of the forces of the tribe of Asher was Pagiel son of Ocran.

The Lord said to Moses, “Gather for me seventy men from the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the leaders and officers of the people. Bring them to the tent of meeting, and let them stand ready there with you.”
A young man ran and reported to Moses, saying to him, “Look, Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

A wind went out from the Lord and brought quail up from the sea and cast them over the camp, a day's journey in one direction and a day's journey in the other, all around the camp, about two cubits above the ground.
From the tribe of Simeon: Shaphat son of Haddi.
They said to one another, “Come, let us appoint a leader for ourselves and return to Egypt.”
According to the number you prepare, do the same for each one, according to their number.
The Lord said to Moses, “The man must be put to death. The whole congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp.”
They rose up before Moses, along with two hundred and fifty men from the Israelites, leaders of the congregation who were summoned to the assembly, men of renown.
Therefore, you and your whole congregation shall assemble before the Lord tomorrow. And Aaron—who is he that you complain against him?
Each man took his censer, and they put fire in them and placed incense in them. They stood before the tent of meeting with Moses and Aaron.
The next day, the whole congregation of the Israelites complained against Moses and Aaron and said to them, “You have killed the Lord's people.”
Write Aaron's name on the staff of Levi, for there shall be one staff for each ancestral household.

The Lord said to Aaron, “Look, I have given you charge of my contributions. All the holy offerings of the Israelites I have given to you by virtue of your anointing, to you and your sons with you, as a lasting ordinance.”
All the firstfruits of their land that they bring to the Lord shall be yours. Everyone in your household who is clean may eat them.

The Levites shall perform the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their guilt. This is a lasting ordinance throughout their generations. They shall receive no inheritance among the Israelites.
He shall burn the cow before him. He shall burn its hide, its blood, and its flesh, together with its dung.

A man who is clean shall gather the cow's ashes and place them outside the camp in a clean place. They shall be kept for the whole congregation of the Israelites, reserved for the water of sprinkling, because it is a sin offering.
Anyone who touches the dead body of any human being will be unclean for seven days.
This is the law when a person dies in a tent: everyone who enters the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, will be unclean for seven days.
The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian went with their divination fees in their hands. They came to Balaam and told him Balak’s words.
He said to them, “Spend the night here, and I will give you an answer according to what the Lord tells me.” So the officials of Moab stayed with Balaam.
They came to Balaam and said to him, “This is what Balak son of Zippor says: ‘Do not let anything keep you from coming to me.’”
Now you too stay here tonight, and I will find out what more the Lord will say to me.
The donkey saw the angel of the Lord and pressed against the wall, crushing Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.
The angel of the Lord went farther and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn aside, either to the right or to the left.
Balak heard that Balaam had come and went out to meet him at the city of Moab, which was on the Arnon border, at the edge of the territory.
God appeared to Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared seven altars and offered bulls and rams on the altars.”
Balak said to Balaam, “Do not curse them at all, and do not bless them at all.”
Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel. He did not go as he had before to seek omens, but turned his face toward the wilderness.
He took up his poetic declaration and said, “Balaam son of Beor declares; the man whose eye is open declares.”
Edom will become his possession, and Seir, the possession of his enemies, will be his. Israel will gain strength.
Legions will come out from the land of the Kittim. They will subjugate Assyria, and they will also subjugate the Hebrews. They too will perish forever.
Israel stayed at Shittim, and the people began to engage in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab.
Take a census of the whole congregation of the Israelites, from twenty years old and upward, by their ancestral households—all in Israel who go out with the army.
The sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These were the prominent men of the congregation who rebelled against Moses and Aaron with Korah’s congregation, and rebelled against the Lord.
These were the clans of Issachar according to their census: sixty-four thousand three hundred.
These were the sons of Gilead: Iezer, the clan of Iezer; Helek, the clan of Helek.
The name of Asher’s daughter was Serah.
The land shall be divided among these as an inheritance according to the number of names.
For the larger groups, increase their inheritance; for the smaller groups, reduce their inheritance. Each shall receive an inheritance according to the number counted.
Their total was twenty-three thousand, counting every male from one month old and upward. They were not counted among the Israelites, because no inheritance was given to them among the Israelites.
The daughters of Zelophehad speak rightly. Give them a possession and an inheritance among their father’s brothers, and establish their father’s inheritance for them.
May the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation.
And one male goat as a sin offering, besides the regular whole burnt offering, its fine-flour offering, and its drink offering.
On the sixth day, eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen year-old lambs without blemish.
If she made a vow in her husband's house, or bound herself by an obligation under oath,

and her husband explicitly cancels them on the day he hears about them, nothing that came from her lips concerning her vows or the obligations she imposed on herself shall stand, because her husband canceled them. The Lord will forgive her.
Moses said to them, “Why have you kept all the females alive?”
The congregation's half of the flock amounted to three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred.
But the soldiers had taken plunder, each for himself.
They went up as far as the Valley of the Grape Cluster and saw the land. They discouraged the Israelites from entering the land that the Lord had given them.
The Lord's anger burned against them that day, and he swore, saying:
Your servants will cross over, armed for battle, before the Lord, as our lord has said.
And Nebo and Baal-meon, whose names had been changed, and Sibmah. They gave names to the towns they built.
Nobah went and captured Kenath [?] and its villages, and named it Nobah after himself.
The Egyptians were burying the firstborn whom the Lord had killed among them. The Lord also carried out judgment against their gods.
The Lord spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab, beside the Jordan across from Jericho.
These are the names of the men who will assign the land to you as an inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
Take one leader from each tribe to divide the land among you.
From the tribe of Ephraim, Kemuel son of Shiphtan.

As for the towns you give from the Israelites' inheritance, give more from those who have much and fewer from those who have little. Each shall give some of his towns to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance he receives.
If he struck him out of hatred, or threw something at him deliberately, and he died, he is a murderer.
If he struck him with his hand out of hostility, intending to kill him, and he died, he is a murderer and must be put to death. The avenger of blood shall kill the murderer when he encounters him.

The congregation shall rescue the killer from the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall send him back to the city of refuge to which he had fled. He shall live there until the death of the high priest who was anointed with the holy oil.
